good: Recognizable figure (Jon Jones) provides immediate credibility and built-in audience interest
Professional production quality with UFC broadcast assets and clear audio

good: Strong hook: fighter's face and name overlay immediately scroll-stopping; professional branding (PFL) adds credibility

Victory celebration frame (arms raised) is visually satisfying and reinforces the win

Hook shows partial name only ('USMAN NUR') — delays full context; no caption reinforcing 'why this KO matters'
Average watch time (8.3s) suggests viewers drop off — add an earlier dramatic payoff or reaction shot to hold attention
reels.top_tip: Move the undefeated record and title context into the hook (first 3s), and add a crowd reaction or dramatic reaction shot after the KO to make it emotionally shareable
